normalization_plan.reason: _week is only used to index the raffle struct inside withdrawWinnings
_entryNum is only a caller supplied index into the entry array of withdrawWinnings
matches is a transient local controlling the payout branch of withdrawWinnings
_cNums is forwarded straight into buyTicket by enterRaffle
_affID is only emitted in the event raised by the enterRaffle flow
_newAddr is the target of the external upgrade call made by upgradeContract
amt is the local copy of prizePool forwarded during the upgrade
_cNums is validated and stored by buyTicket
_entrant is the address key under which the entry is stored by buyTicket
_value is the wei amount added to prizePool by buyTicket
_affID is only used in the event emitted by buyTicket
_week selects the raffle struct whose sales determine the disbursed profit
oracTot is the local oracle cost subtracted inside disburseFunds
profit is the local take amount forwarded by disburseFunds
curWeek is the transient timestamp derived week index returned by getWeek
_myID is only used to look up the qID mapping inside __callback
_result is the oracle payload consumed by __callback
query is the transient id of the next oraclize call issued by __callback
delay is the transient schedule value used for the next oraclize query in __callback
